caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a fragment of a sculpted architectural element, resembling a volute from an Ionic capital. It has an off-white, stone-like texture with areas of visible greenish patina or discoloration scattered irregularly across its surface. The right side of the object features a spiral, circular form typical of Ionic capitals, and several parallel, horizontal grooves run along its length. The top of the fragment shows a small rectangular recess. The object is oriented horizontally, with the broken, irregular end on the left and the more finished, rounded spiral end on the right. The background remains unadorned and does not include any additional objects or elements.
title: Whiffle Tree End
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
